newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch bonds ended mixed to lower on Tuesday after a day in which traders focused on the new tap issue, maturing February 2007, but did little trade in it.
"The market closely watched the tap, but finally not a lot of big deals were done," one dealer said. He added most trade on the tap was done by professional players.
At 1600 GMT, the Dutch Finance Ministry announced it had raised 4.7 billion guilders under the new issue so far, a 1.1 billion guilders increase compared to yesterday.
